result.reason: The clause adopts the preferred frequency, 30-day written notice, business-hours limitation, independent confidentiality-bound auditor, and prohibition on systems access. Retaining HDI’s obligation to bear all audit costs is more protective of the Company than the preferred position and preserves the original allocation. The edits are targeted and professionally drafted, though the inherited phrasing (“have the right to inspect” and references to each party’s General Manager) remains somewhat awkward.
